summary:
The Singapore Football League (SFL) is Singapore’s second- and third-tier football competition for clubs affiliated with the Football Association of Singapore. Founded in 1975 as the National Football League, it was the country’s top league until 1988, when the FAS Premier League took over. The fully professional Singapore Premier League replaced that competition in 1996.

The SFL now has two divisions, mostly amateur, with some semi-professional clubs. Division Two teams can be promoted from the Island Wide League, Singapore’s fourth tier, but SFL clubs cannot advance to the Singapore Premier League, which has no promotion or relegation. SFL teams are eligible for the Singapore FA Cup.

Singapore Khalsa Association won Division One from 2022 to 2024; Singapore Cricket Club won in 2025. The 2026 season is scheduled to continue into 2027 to align with the Singapore Premier League.
